{'text': '根據Sensor Tower一份新報告，Meta旗下嘅Muse不單止成為有史以來第12個喺40日內達到1,000萬次美國下載量嘅應用程式，喺用戶留存率方面亦領先同類對手。詳情如下。', 'paragraph_context': 'According to a new report from Sensor Tower, not only did Meta’s Muse become the 12th app ever to reach 10 million US downloads in 40 days, but it is also outpacing its peers in user retention. Here are the details.'}

{'text': 'Meta Muse喺私隱爭議下持續增長', 'paragraph_context': 'Meta Muse keeps growing amid privacy controversy'}

{'text': '幾星期前，Sensor Tower曾報導，Meta嘅Muse應用程式憑藉人氣同Meta鋪天盖地嘅廣告攻勢，已經喺美國突破500萬次下載量。', 'paragraph_context': 'A few weeks ago, Sensor Tower reported that Meta’s Muse app had surpassed 5 million downloads in the US, thanks to a mix of popularity and Meta’s massive ad push.'}

{'text': '當時，該應用程式已經連續12日喺美國App Store榜首。Muse之後滑落至第二位，但Sensor Tower最新報告指，自該公司2015年10月開始追蹤應用程式以嚟，Muse係第12個喺推出後40日內達到1,000萬次美國下載量嘅應用程式。', 'paragraph_context': 'At the time, the app had spent 12 consecutive days at the top of the US App Store. Muse has since slipped to second place, but Sensor Tower now reports that it has become just the 12th app to reach 10 million US downloads within 40 days of launch, since the firm began tracking apps in October 2015.'}

{'text': '作為比較，Sensor Tower表示，ChatGPT、Grok同Claude喺推出後頭40日嘅美國下載量，分別只有370萬、50萬同20萬。', 'paragraph_context': 'For comparison, Sensor Tower says ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude reached just 3.7 million, 500,000, and 200,000 US downloads, respectively, during their first 40 days.'}

{'text': '根據Sensor Tower嘅數據，ChatGPT喺應用程式推出後頭40日全球下載量達到約1,500萬次，因為其全球覆蓋加速咗增長速度。喺研究期間，ChatGPT下載量最多嘅地區包括美國、日本、巴西同德國，分別佔全球下載量嘅25%、9%、6%同5%。', 'paragraph_context': 'Per Sensor Tower data, ChatGPT scaled to ~15mn global downloads in its first 40 days post app-launch, as its global reach expedited its growth. ChatGPT’s top regions by downloads during the studied period included the US, Japan, Brazil, and Germany, which accounted for 25%, 9%, 6%, and 5% of the global downloads, respectively.'}

{'text': '報告亦指出，ChatGPT嘅美國下載量喺過去30日較對上一個30日期間下跌咗25%。ChatGPT而家係美國App Store上第四大最多人下載嘅免費應用程式，而Claude排第七，Grok排第34。', 'paragraph_context': 'The report also noted that ChatGPT’s US downloads have declined 25% over the past 30 days compared to the previous 30-day period. ChatGPT is currently the fourth most downloaded free app on the US App Store, while Claude ranks seventh and Grok 34th.'}

{'text': '至於其他喺40日內達到1,000萬下載量里程碑嘅應用程式，Sensor Tower冇逐一列舉，但指出當中有9個係手機遊戲。最近一個達到呢個成績嘅應用程式係Meta自己嘅Threads，喺2023年7月。', 'paragraph_context': 'As for the other apps that reached the 10 million milestone within 40 days, Sensor Tower didn’t name them all, but noted that nine were mobile games. The most recent app to achieve the feat was Meta’s own Threads, back in July 2023.'}

{'text': 'M.C.嘅熱門留言', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by M.C.'}

{'text': '我真係冇辦法再畀更多自己嘅資料Meta。我已經成功減少咗用Facebook，唔會再走返去畀佢攞多過之前嘅資料。', 'paragraph_context': "I just can't give Meta any more data on me. I've successfully limited my use of Facebook. I'm not about to jump back in and give them more than I had before."}

{'text': '今日嘅報告出台之際，Muse正面對新一輪私隱憂慮——有安全研究人員發現，共享對話可能會洩露敏感嘅個人同商業資料。Meta其後已經暫停咗分享功能，並正調查事件。', 'paragraph_context': 'Today’s report comes amid fresh privacy concerns surrounding Muse, after security researchers discovered that shared conversations could expose sensitive personal and business information. Meta has since suspended the sharing feature while it investigates the issue.'}

{'text': '儘管有私隱疑慮，Sensor Tower嘅數據顯示Muse喺留住用戶方面比AI對手做得更好，而呢點一啲都唔令人意外，因為呢樣正正係Meta嘅最強項之一：', 'paragraph_context': 'Despite the privacy concerns, Sensor Tower’s data suggests that Muse is doing a better job of retaining users than its AI competitors, which is not surprising, since this is one of Meta’s strongest suits:'}

{'text': '美國嘅Muse用戶持續返到訪該應用程式，7日後平均留存率為30%，14日後則為23%。喺7日同14日嘅留存率方面，Meta而家領先其他AI對手，ChatGPT、Claude同Grok嘅平均留存率分別為19%同16%。', 'paragraph_context': 'US Muse users are returning to the app, which is averaging a 30% retention rate after 7 days, and a 23% retention rate after 14 days. Meta is currently outpacing AI competitors in its retention at the 7 and 14 day mark, as ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok averaged a 19% and 16% retention rate, respectively.'}

{'text': '最後，Sensor Tower指出Meta繼續大灑金錢宣傳其AI助理。根據報告，該應用程式喺本月至今佔Meta美國廣告開支嘅39%，較9月嘅23%有所上升。據報Muse喺美國品牌廣告曝光量排名中亦由第73位升至第21位。', 'paragraph_context': 'Finally, Sensor Tower notes that Meta continues spending heavily to promote its AI assistant. According to the report, the app accounted for 39% of Meta’s advertising spend in the US so far this month, up from 23% in September. Muse also reportedly climbed from 73rd to 21st place among US brands ranked by advertising impressions.'}

{'text': '你有冇用過Meta嘅Muse應用程式？欢迎喺留言區告訴我哋。', 'paragraph_context': 'Have you been using Meta’s Muse app? Let us know in the comments.'}
